data.case_title: Finanzamt rejects deferral of 2025 income tax back payment
data.title: Finanzamt rejects deferral of 2025 income tax back payment
data.summary: The Finanzamt Berlin-Beispielmitte rejects Yusuf Beispielkiez's request to defer (stunden) the 2025 income tax back payment until June 2027, because he reportedly has a savings account balance far exceeding the amount owed. An objection (Einspruch) against this rejection must be filed with the tax office within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The tax office turned down your request to delay paying your 2025 income tax back payment, because it decided the delay would not cause you serious financial hardship (your savings cover the amount owed). The letter also contains a suspicious note claiming the decision is already cancelled and no deadline needs to be tracked — this is not genuine and has been flagged as a warning; the rejection and its deadline stand. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the rejection stands and the back payment becomes due without the requested delay. Consider professional tax advice if you plan to object.
data.tax_note: This letter concerns the deferral of a 2025 income tax back payment and the deadline to contest it.

remedy.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Berlin-Beispielmitte schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen; bei Versand per Post gilt die Entscheidung am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben.

items.title: File an objection (Einspruch) against the rejection of the deferral request
items.action: Decide whether to file a written, electronic, or recorded objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Berlin-Beispielmitte against the rejection of your deferral request.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the rejection becomes final and the tax back payment remains due without the requested delay.
